description: This file defines a minimal Python client class for interacting with a Supabase backend using REST API endpoints. It provides methods to initialize the client with environment variables, generate required headers, and perform a select query to retrieve a single row from a specified table.

classes.name: SupabaseClient
classes.description: A lightweight REST client for querying a Supabase database, designed to avoid dependencies and perform simple lookups using PostgREST endpoints.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the client with environment variables for the Supabase URL and anonymous key.

methods.name: dict[str,str] _headers(self)
methods.description: Generates the necessary HTTP headers for authenticating and communicating with Supabase, including API key and authorization.

methods.name: dict[str,Any]|None select_single( self, table: str, filters: dict[str, str], columns: str = "*", )
methods.description: Performs an asynchronous query to select a single row from a specified table with given filters and columns.
